title: Papierowa menażeria
evidence: Guest article contains Anna Gralak’s complete Polish translation by Ken Liu, from the paper animals opening to folding Laohu again and walking home. The final scene matches the original and is followed by author and translator credits.

title: Wśród obcych
evidence: Direct guest download returned HTTP 200 and a 298-page Polish PDF by Jo Walton. It begins in Abercwmboi, includes the final scene and plans for exams, then acknowledgments and notes. The host’s landing page only shows a 20-page preview. Rights unknown.

title: Czerwone koszule
evidence: Direct guest download returned HTTP 200 and a 259-page Polish PDF by John Scalzi. Prologue, chapter 24 and all three codas are present, including the final third-person coda and acknowledgments. Rights unknown.

title: Zabójcza sprawiedliwość
evidence: Direct guest download returned HTTP 200 and a 220-page Polish PDF by Ann Leckie. It opens with Breq finding Seivarden in the snow and reaches their final scene before the acknowledgments and interview. Rights unknown.

title: Wszystkie wskaźniki czerwone
evidence: Guest HTML sample contains about 5,250 words from Martha Wells’s opening Murderbot novella, translated by Marek Pawelec. The sample explicitly ends with a purchase prompt. It does not include the second novella named in the listing.

title: Dziewczę, które poszło na sushi
evidence: Guest publisher PDF opens on physical page 12, printed page 39. It contains the opening narrative with Fry and Arkae in Pat Cadigan’s work, translated by Konrad Walewski. The following PDF page belongs to a different article.

title: Sześć miesięcy i trzy dni
evidence: Guest publisher PDF opens on physical page 15, printed page 54. The opening of Charlie Jane Anders’s story with Doug and Judy is present in Piotr Kosiński’s Polish translation. Only that page of the story appears in the preview.

title: Wrota obelisków
evidence: Guest HTML excerpt from N. K. Jemisin’s novel contains the Polish opening narrative addressed to Essun. It is a standalone readable sample on Gavran, distinct from the existing retailer listing.
